```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// ————— Shared helpers (copy verbatim into every lab; do not import) —————
plotStyle = ({
  background: "transparent",
  color: "var(--bs-body-color)",
  fontFamily: "Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif"
})

function formatSigned(value, digits = 2) {
  if (Math.abs(value) < 0.5 * Math.pow(10, -digits)) return (0).toFixed(digits);
  return (value > 0 ? "+" : "−") + Math.abs(value).toFixed(digits);
}

// Deterministic PRNG: the same seed gives the same draws on every load, so a
// toggled control changes only what it is meant to change.
function mulberry32(a) {
  return function () {
    a |= 0; a = (a + 0x6D2B79F5) | 0;
    let t = Math.imul(a ^ (a >>> 15), 1 | a);
    t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  };
}

function gaussian(rng) {
  let spare = null;
  return function () {
    if (spare !== null) { const v = spare; spare = null; return v; }
    let u = 0; while (u === 0) u = rng();
    const r = Math.sqrt(-2 * Math.log(u)), th = 2 * Math.PI * rng();
    spare = r * Math.sin(th);
    return r * Math.cos(th);
  };
}

// OLS by solving the normal equations with Gaussian elimination and partial
// pivoting. X is an array of rows; the first column should be 1 for an
// intercept. Returns coefficients, residuals, and (X'X)^{-1}.
function ols(y, X) {
  const n = y.length, k = X[0].length;
  const XtX = Array.from({ length: k }, () => new Array(k).fill(0));
  const Xty = new Array(k).fill(0);
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const xi = X[i];
    for (let a = 0; a < k; a++) {
      Xty[a] += xi[a] * y[i];
      for (let b = a; b < k; b++) XtX[a][b] += xi[a] * xi[b];
    }
  }
  for (let a = 0; a < k; a++) for (let b = 0; b < a; b++) XtX[a][b] = XtX[b][a];
  const inv = invert(XtX);
  const beta = inv.map(row => row.reduce((s, v, j) => s + v * Xty[j], 0));
  const resid = y.map((yi, i) => yi - X[i].reduce((s, v, j) => s + v * beta[j], 0));
  return { beta, resid, XtXinv: inv, n, k };
}

function invert(A) {
  const n = A.length;
  const M = A.map((row, i) => [...row, ...Array.from({ length: n }, (_, j) => (i === j ? 1 : 0))]);
  for (let c = 0; c < n; c++) {
    let p = c;
    for (let r = c + 1; r < n; r++) if (Math.abs(M[r][c]) > Math.abs(M[p][c])) p = r;
    [M[c], M[p]] = [M[p], M[c]];
    const piv = M[c][c];
    for (let j = 0; j < 2 * n; j++) M[c][j] /= piv;
    for (let r = 0; r < n; r++) if (r !== c) {
      const f = M[r][c];
      for (let j = 0; j < 2 * n; j++) M[r][j] -= f * M[c][j];
    }
  }
  return M.map(row => row.slice(n));
}

// Heteroskedasticity-robust (HC1) standard errors for an ols() result.
function hcSe(fit, X) {
  const { resid, XtXinv, n, k } = fit;
  const meat = Array.from({ length: k }, () => new Array(k).fill(0));
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const e2 = resid[i] * resid[i];
    for (let a = 0; a < k; a++) for (let b = 0; b < k; b++) meat[a][b] += e2 * X[i][a] * X[i][b];
  }
  const V = matmul(matmul(XtXinv, meat), XtXinv);
  const c = n / (n - k);
  return V.map((row, j) => Math.sqrt(c * row[j]));
}

// Newey–West (Bartlett kernel) standard errors with bandwidth m.
function neweyWestSe(fit, X, m) {
  const { resid, XtXinv, n, k } = fit;
  const S = Array.from({ length: k }, () => new Array(k).fill(0));
  const g = resid.map((e, i) => X[i].map(x => x * e));
  for (let l = 0; l <= m; l++) {
    const w = l === 0 ? 1 : 1 - l / (m + 1);
    for (let t = l; t < n; t++) {
      for (let a = 0; a < k; a++) for (let b = 0; b < k; b++) {
        const v = g[t][a] * g[t - l][b];
        S[a][b] += w * (l === 0 ? v : v + g[t - l][a] * g[t][b]);
      }
    }
  }
  const V = matmul(matmul(XtXinv, S), XtXinv);
  return V.map((row, j) => Math.sqrt(row[j]));
}

function matmul(A, B) {
  return A.map(row => B[0].map((_, j) => row.reduce((s, v, i) => s + v * B[i][j], 0)));
}

// One local projection at horizon h: regress y[t+h] on 1, s[t], and the
// listed controls (each an array aligned with t). Returns the coefficient on
// s, its HC1 and Newey–West(h) standard errors, and the row count.
function localProjection(y, s, controls, h, opts = {}) {
  const rows = [], Y = [];
  for (let t = 0; t + h < y.length; t++) {
    const row = [1, s[t], ...controls.map(c => c[t])];
    if (row.some(v => v === null || Number.isNaN(v)) || y[t + h] == null) continue;
    rows.push(row); Y.push(y[t + h]);
  }
  const fit = ols(Y, rows);
  return {
    beta: fit.beta[1],
    seHC: hcSe(fit, rows)[1],
    seNW: neweyWestSe(fit, rows, opts.bandwidth ?? h)[1],
    n: rows.length
  };
}
```
